chapters.title: Introduction and Dutch Women in Tech
The 90-day approach and the first 30 days

takeaways: Copilot adoption is about building new behavior, not about the technology itself.
A weekly rhythm of a Monday tip, a Wednesday Q&A and Friday knowledge sharing helps users turn Copilot into a habit.
Start with a few critical features, support middle management and plan for the embedding phase after the rollout.
hook: Many Copilot rollouts stall because organizations focus on licenses and features instead of people. MVP Carina de Vries shares her 90-day approach for adoption leads and IT managers: how to define happy users, build Copilot habits with a weekly cadence and embed new ways of working after the project ends.
